justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/comparator/LastModifiedFileComparator.java and src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/comparator/AbstractFileComparator.java, plus src/test/java/org/apache/commons/io/comparator/LastModifiedFileComparatorTest.java. The target class is only 92 lines and contains one behavior method (`compare`), two singleton constants, and an empty constructor; its sole responsibility is comparing two files by `FileUtils.lastModifiedUnchecked(...)` and returning -1/0/1. The shared sorting helpers live in AbstractFileComparator, so this class is narrow and cohesive rather than under-decomposed.
